name: Business and Data Analyst - eCommerce SME
description_html:
Who We Are

Intrepid Asia is a leading Ecommerce and Digital Solutions Provider in South East Asia. We offer end-to-end omni-channel ecommerce management, Livestreaming, Video production & Affiliate Management for Social Commerce, plus full funnel Digital Marketing Services and advanced Market Intelligence, all powered by state-of-the-art in-house Technology to our client base of leading international brands across all key marketplaces and social platforms in all 6 SEA countries. Brands love our regional presence, our excellent data-driven, growth-focused services, enabled by the industry's strongest team, and our advanced marketing and tech capabilities.

We are growing rapidly, and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end.

The Role

We are looking for a BA/DA — eCommerce Operations to become Intrepid's dedicated e-commerce operations and finance analytics subject-matter expert across the region, based in Thailand, while acting as the go-to operations and finance data resource for country teams across all six SEA markets we operate in.

This is a hybrid role by design. You will own e-commerce operations and finance analytics requirements end-to-end — discovering what country operations and finance teams actually need, translating it into a solvable data problem, and then doing the hands-on SQL, dashboard, and reconciliation work yourself, working hand-in-hand with our central Data Engineering and BI team (based in Vietnam and Indonesia) in a hub-and-spoke model. You are not a traditional, non-technical BA who hands off requirements and waits — nor a pure data analyst who builds what's asked without questioning it. You are the person who connects marketplace operations — pricing, promotions, fulfilment, and SKU/category performance — to financial outcomes, and who is experienced enough to surface discrepancies and signals nobody has thought to ask about yet.

The world is moving past the era of the static dashboard. Stakeholders no longer just want a chart to interpret — they want AI-native, proactive insight: analytics that surfaces what matters before anyone has to go looking for it, flags anomalies and drivers automatically, and arrives with a narrative and a recommendation attached, not just a number. In operations and finance, that means catching a pricing error, a margin leak, or a reconciliation discrepancy before month-end close, not after. We want this role to help lead that shift inside Intrepid's e-commerce operations domain, not simply maintain the reporting model it's replacing.

You will work directly with data flowing through Intrepid's own PowerSell e-commerce platform and Finance Data Warehouse, as well as marketplace operations data crawled or pulled via official API from Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop Seller Centres, and third-party market intelligence and digital shelf data. Data accuracy has been a real, active challenge for our dashboards; this role is central to closing that gap between operational and financial reporting — and to reimagining what ops and finance reporting looks like once it isn't just a dashboard anymore.

Key Responsibilities2. Analysis & Solutioning — Domain and Technical3. Insight Delivery & Stakeholder Management4. Governance, Documentation & Scale5. AI-Native Analytics & Proactive Insight Generation

  • Discovery & Requirements
  • Lead requirement-gathering conversations and workshops with e-commerce operations and finance stakeholders, and support country operations and finance leads across all six SEA markets
  • Map how operations and finance data flows across PowerSell, the Finance Data Warehouse, and marketplace Seller Centre sources, to identify what a country team actually needs versus what they're asking for
  • Translate open-ended questions (e.g. "why is reported GMV not matching finance's reconciled revenue for this market") into concrete, structured data requirements
  • Maintain a prioritized backlog of operations and finance analytics requests, working the hub-and-spoke model with the central Data Engineering / BI team in Vietnam and Indonesia
  • Own end-to-end e-commerce operations analytics: SKU/category performance, pricing and promotions, marketplace P&L, and fulfilment/returns — reconciled against Finance Data Warehouse actuals
  • Write your own SQL and build/validate your own dashboards rather than fully depending on the central BI team — pairing with a Vietnam- or Indonesia-based analyst for heavier pipeline or engineering work
  • Validate and reconcile operations and finance numbers against each other, escalating recurring data quality or reconciliation issues to the central Data Governance & Quality function
  • Interpret third-party market intelligence and digital shelf vendor data for competitive and category context, understanding the strengths and known limitations of each data source
  • Present operations and finance insights and recommendations directly to country operations and finance leads and regional leadership — not just a finished dashboard, but a point of view on what to do next
  • Proactively surface non-obvious patterns and discrepancies across markets, rather than only answering questions as they're asked
  • Act as the operations and finance domain's voice within Data & Analytics, feeding requirements into the central data engineering roadmap — including Intrepid's ongoing move from crawled Seller Centre data to official platform APIs for commercial and operational metrics
  • Maintain operations and finance-specific metric definitions (e.g. GMV, net revenue, category margin), feeding into Intrepid's broader BI Business Glossary and semantic layer
  • Document reconciliation methodology between operational and financial reporting to ensure consistency of definitions across all six markets
  • Contribute to operations and finance data quality monitoring, flagging recurring issues as candidates for automation
  • Use AI tools such as Claude to move operations and finance reporting from reactive, end-of-month reconciliation toward proactive, continuous insight — automated anomaly and discrepancy detection, and "so what" summaries generated alongside the numbers
  • Prototype and pilot AI-assisted analytics workflows — automated reconciliation-variance alerts, pricing/margin anomaly detection, natural-language querying over operations and finance data — in partnership with the central Data Engineering team
  • Continuously evaluate where GenAI can replace manual, repetitive reconciliation and reporting effort, and hand off validated use cases into Intrepid's broader AI transformation and automation roadmap

Requirements

Technical & Data Capabilities

  • Hands-on SQL and dashboarding experience (e.g. Apache Superset, Looker, Power BI, or similar), with the ability to validate and reconcile data from multiple sources yourself
  • Working knowledge of e-commerce operations data structures — SKU/category, pricing and promotions, fulfilment and returns — and basic finance/reconciliation concepts (GMV vs. net revenue, margin, accruals)
  • Experience with or exposure to marketplace Seller Centre data (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop) and finance data warehouse reporting is a strong plus
  • Comfort working with third-party vendor datasets (market intelligence, digital shelf) and reconciling discrepancies between sources
  • Genuine, hands-on experience using Claude or other GenAI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini) for real analytical work — generating and debugging SQL, summarizing large or messy datasets, drafting stakeholder-ready insight narratives — not just casual or occasional use
  • Comfort experimenting with AI agents or no/low-code workflow automation tools (e.g. n8n) to prototype proactive, always-on insight generation rather than one-off, on-request dashboard pulls
  • Working prompt-engineering literacy — able to get reliable, decision-useful analytical output from an AI tool, and to know when to trust it and when to verify it

Operations & Finance Domain and Business Analyst Capabilities

  • Deep understanding of e-commerce marketplace operations: pricing and promotions mechanics, fulfilment and returns, and category/SKU management
  • Working understanding of finance and reconciliation concepts sufficient to bridge operational and financial reporting
  • Strong requirements-gathering and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate with minimal oversight across multiple country operations and finance teams
  • Excellent communication skills, able to bridge business/operations, finance, and technical/data audiences

Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of combined experience across e-commerce operations analytics, finance analytics, business analysis, or data analysis roles
  • Prior experience in e-commerce marketplace operations or finance reporting in Southeast Asia
  • Experience covering multiple markets or countries remotely from a regional hub
  • Exposure to finance reconciliation or data warehouse reporting systems
  • Prior experience building or piloting an AI-assisted or automated reporting/insight workflow, even informally, is a strong plus

Benefits

Why Join Intrepid

  • Shape e-commerce operations and finance analytics for a leading e-commerce enabler operating across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam
  • Be the first dedicated operations and finance SME in this role, shaping how the function operates region-wide from the ground up
  • Help lead Intrepid's shift from static, end-of-month reporting to AI-native, proactive operations and finance insight — you'll be defining what that looks like, not inheriting someone else's legacy reporting model
  • Work directly with real marketplace and finance data — flowing from Intrepid's own PowerSell platform and Finance Data Warehouse — not theoretical frameworks

In return, you will be getting

  • We are building 'the operating system for digital commerce in South East Asia' covering all key platforms, working with leading international brands, with a breadth and depth of functionalities (Middleware, OMS, Inventory mgmt, Store Ops, CX, MarTech, Data & Analytics) that few in the industry can match
  • You get the chance to work on exciting SaaS projects and sophisticated features and functionalities that will make a big impact in the industry, on a top-notch scalable infrastructure
  • Our Tech team has been around since 2017, so you will join a well-oiled and stable "machine" (= rockstar expert team), where processes are well established and enterprise-grade. But at the same time, our organisation is non-hierarchical, entrepreneurial and collaborative, and working on cool stuff, so you get the best of both worlds
  • Tech is a strategic pillar for intrepid, so you will feel the love and recognition for your work, and will partner closely with business stakeholders, who as internal users of the tech will provide the real-world feedback and inputs which help to take our tech stack to the next level

We also offer

Best of Both Worlds

We are a scale up: the sophistication of a small multinational, with the agility of a start-up. This means you get to work on cutting-edge projects, and besides your 'standard' job description, we love to see you show entrepreneurial initiative and want to see your take on how you can take your role and our company to the next level. Good ideas get implemented. You are the master of your own destiny.

Culture that Brings Out the Best

At Intrepid, culture is not just a buzzword, it is what we practice at work every day. We believe in collaboration over competition, transparency over politics, and willingness to learn over ego. You will be part of a team where people genuinely support one another, celebrate wins together, and face challenges head-on as one. We put our all into the work but we balance it with fun, whether that is through team lunches, after-work hangouts, events or shared laughter in the office. This is a place where you can thrive professionally while having a great time.

Grow Without Limits

Learning at Intrepid is constant and dynamic. You will have access to formal training through face-to-face sessions, coaching and our very own Intrepid Academy. On top of that, real-world experience such as leading clients, working with advanced tech, and mastering best-in-class processes will accelerate your growth every step of the way. Surrounded by a talented team that raises the bar daily, in a rapidly growing and ever-expanding business, the opportunities for your development are endless.

Rewarding You Right

We believe great work deserves great rewards at Intrepid. That's why we offer competitive compensation and generous benefits, including comprehensive insurance and ample leave, to support you both in and out of the workplace. We want you to feel valued, cared for, and empowered to bring your best self to work every day.

Note: We will not be accepting any unsolicited resumes or CVs from headhunting or recruitment agencies at this point. Any CVs or profiles shared with us will not be entertained, and in the event of dispute, Intrepid will not be liable for any material compensation to third parties

name: Senior System Administrator, Business Application Management
description_html:
Key Job Purpose

The Senior System Administrator is responsible for the operational support, administration and continuous improvement of SAP Business application across the Asia Pacific (AP) region of Sysmex. The primary focus is on SAP S/4HANA Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes, SAP Global Trade Security (GTS) processes, and the integration between S/4HANA OTC, GTS and other Business Application within Sysmex AP application landscape, as well as with our external Business Partner’s Business Application.

The role serves first point of contact for application incidents and service requests, performs functional analysis and coordinates issue resolution with business users, internal IT teams and external SAP consultants. The position also supports system changes, testing, release deployment, user access administration and compliance documentation to maintain stable, secure and controlled business application operations.

In addition, the role acts as the support to Material Master Data Governance Leads, driving material master data standards, governance controls, data quality and SAP MDG processes across the SAP landscape. The role works closely with business process owners, data owners and key users to translate operational and governance requirements into sustainable functional solutions.

Work Location

Sysmex Malaysia Office - Glenmarie, Shah Alam

Sysmex Indonesia Office - Kuningan, South Jakarta

Candidates will be based in their respective home country office (Malaysia or Indonesia) and are not required to relocate between the two locations.

Summary Of Functional Duties & Responsibilities

A

SAP Application Support and Operations

Provide first-level functional and technical support for SAP S/4HANA and SAP GTS applications, with particular focus on Order-to-Cash and GTS processes and the integration

  • Between S/4HANA OTC and GTS application,
  • With MS Dynamic CRM system of Sysmex AP,
  • With Master Data Governance (MDG) system of Sysmex Corporation,
  • With Business Applications of our external Business Partners such as 4th Party Logistic (4PL) and 3rd Party Logistic (3PL) partners.

Manage incidents, service requests and application issues by performing initial analysis, troubleshooting and root cause analysis, and coordinating resolution with internal support teams and external SAP consultants.

Monitor recurring application and data issues, identify improvement opportunities and recommend preventive or corrective actions to improve system stability and operational efficiency.

Support day-to-day SAP operational activities and ensure that business-critical issues are appropriately prioritized, communicated, documented and resolved.

B

Material Master Data Governance

Support Material Master Data Governance Lead, Data Owner and Stewards to coordinate the definition, implementation and continuous improvement of material master data standards, policies, ownership and governance processes.

Support SAP MDG processes covering material creation, extension, change, approval workflows, validation rules, duplicate prevention and data replication to SAP S/4HANA, SAP GTS and other relevant systems.

Work with data owners, business process owners and key users to define data quality requirements, resolve governance issues and ensure the completeness, consistency and accuracy of material master data.

Coordinate data validation, cleansing, remediation and basic migration activities relating to material master data.

Monitor material master data quality and governance compliance, identify recurring data issues and support the implementation of sustainable corrective actions and controls.

C

Business Analysis and Solution Delivery

Engage business process owners, data owners and key users to gather, analyse and document business, system and data governance requirements.

Perform process and gap analysis, impact assessment and cost-benefit analysis to support solution recommendations and implementation decisions.

Translate business and data governance requirements into clear functional specifications, process designs, validation requirements and test scenarios.

Support the configuration, enhancement and deployment of SAP functionalities relating to OTC, Material Management, Warehouse Management and Master Data Governance, where applicable.

Coordinate with internal IT teams, business stakeholders and external consultants to ensure that solutions meet operational, security, compliance and architectural requirements.

D

Testing, Change and Release Management

Prepare test plans, test scenarios, test data and User Acceptance Testing scripts for system enhancements, patches, upgrades and master data governance changes.

Execute or coordinate unit, integration and regression testing, document results, manage defects and support business users during User Acceptance Testing.

Support SAP change requests throughout the delivery lifecycle, including requirement assessment, solution review, testing, transport coordination, deployment and post-implementation validation.

Participate in SAP transport, release and change management processes to ensure changes are properly authorized, tested, documented and deployed.

Support post-implementation activities, including issue resolution, stabilization, documentation updates and knowledge transfer.

E

User Administration, Governance and Compliance

Perform or coordinate SAP user administration activities, including user onboarding, access changes, periodic user and licence reviews and access removal.

Coordinate user access requirements in accordance with Business Application Management, IT cybersecurity, audit and Segregation of Duties requirements.

Maintain accurate and current system documentation, functional specifications, test evidence, support records, data governance procedures and operational work instructions.

Ensure that application support, system changes and master data governance activities comply with applicable internal standards and relevant CSV, J-SOX, ISO, cybersecurity and audit requirements.

Support internal and external audit requests by providing relevant system, access, change and master data governance documentation.

F

Stakeholder and Knowledge Management

Build effective working relationships with regional business users, process owners, data owners, key users, internal IT teams and external service providers.

Communicate application issues, risks, dependencies and implementation progress clearly to relevant stakeholders.

Develop and maintain user guides, support procedures and knowledge materials, and conduct knowledge-sharing or user training sessions where required.

Promote the adoption of standard processes, governance controls, automation and appropriate digital or AI-enabled tools to improve support quality and operational efficiency.

Job Specification

Minimum Education Required:

Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Minimum Experience Required

  • At least five years of relevant experience in implementing, supporting or administering SAP S/4HANA or SAP ECC 6.0 business applications.

name: Senior Specification Engineer (IT Business Analyst)
description_html:
The role


Turn business intent into requirements that engineers can build and QA can test. This is hands-on specification engineering. You report to the CEO and work with the CTO, QA, engineers and business counterparts. You own editorial precision. Changes to approved business meaning, scope or architecture go to the relevant business authority, the CEO or the CTO.

This is not a product-owner or roadmap role. You will not own the roadmap, pricing or revenue targets. You will own the requirements: what the system must do, where each rule came from, who approved it, and how QA can prove it. Your first assignment is a fund management platform.

If you are a senior Business Analyst, System Analyst, Requirements Engineer or technical Product Owner, and you value precision more than slide decks, this role is for you.


What you will do

Discovery and user understanding

  • Plan and run stakeholder interviews, workflow discovery and user research to find goals, constraints, exceptions and unmet needs.
  • Turn findings into clear problem statements, user journeys and priorities. Validate proposed flows and usability with intended users before they become build commitments.

Requirements and decisions

  • Write versioned requirements with an ID, source evidence, approval record, explicit dependencies and acceptance criteria that QA can turn into positive, negative and boundary cases.
  • Turn ambiguity or contradiction into a decision request: the issue, the evidence, the decision owner, your proposed default and the requested action.
  • Keep a decision ledger, so that no ruling stays informal. Keep scope, open questions and approved decisions visible to engineering and business stakeholders.

Product design and delivery alignment

  • Shape user flows, interaction requirements and usability acceptance criteria with engineering and business counterparts.
  • Keep module boundaries and traceability current after approved semantic changes. Make the implementation impact visible before a boundary changes.

QA and engineering handoff

  • Give QA the exact approved revision, acceptance basis and dependencies before the affected build starts.
  • Resolve or escalate the material testability gaps that QA returns. The affected build stays blocked until the gap is resolved or its approval owner excludes that scope.

AI-enabled practice

  • Use AI to draft and reconcile specifications. Check every AI-drafted clause against its source, and document your method.
  • Improve the tools and templates that keep requirements, decisions and traceability easy to maintain, such as ID issuance, traceability and contradiction checks.

What you need

  • 5+ years of business analysis, specification engineering or product experience, delivering enterprise transactional or approval-driven systems from discovery through release.
  • Strong user-research skills: you plan interviews and workflow observations, separate evidence from assumptions, and turn findings into user journeys and requirements.
  • Practical UX understanding: clear navigation, interaction states, error recovery and accessibility. You can assess wireframes or prototypes and validate usability with intended users.
  • Precise requirement writing and decision discipline. QA can test your acceptance criteria without asking what you meant.
  • You read data models, API contracts and tests with engineers, and you reason about delivery trade-offs.
  • Clear written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia and English, including facilitation of stakeholder reviews and decisions.
  • Practical AI proficiency, with source verification and a documented method.

Nice to have

  • 7+ years of relevant experience.
  • Financial-industry experience: fund management, custody, securities settlement, banking or payments.
  • B2B delivery with a client-side sign-off chain.
  • You have shipped a product built on a language model.

name: Estate Management Process Lead -S/4 HANA
description_html:
Job Description Summary:

The Estate Management Process Lead is the functional authority for the "Upstream Estate" operations within the SAP implementation program. This role bridges the gap between the physical reality of palm oil plantation management—ranging from Land Preparation and Nursery to Upkeep and Harvesting—and the digital ecosystem comprising SAP S/4HANA and specialized connected applications.

This role is responsible for safeguarding the integrity of the end-to-end process, ensuring that requirements for operational data, planning data are clearly communicated to the respective system owners, and to integrate seamlessly with SAP Project Systems (PS), Plant Maintenance (PM), Materials Management (MM) and Controlling (CO). The mandate is to ensure the solution delivers fit-for-purpose estate processes, accurate operational reporting, precise cost capture, and strict compliance with sustainability standards (EUDR/RSPO) at the source.


Job Description:

1. Detailed Design & Solution Build

  • Requirement Definition & RICEFW Validation: Drives the detailed requirements gathering workshops for Upstream operations. Validates the functional specifications and configuration designs produced by the SAP Functional Team (PM, PS, CO) to ensure they meet business needs. This includes validating RICEFW (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, Workflows) objects.
  • Lifecycle Design: Ensures the SAP design accurately reflects the unique stages and operational requirements of the plantation lifecycle.


2. Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Test Leadership (SIT & UAT): Leads the System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for the Estate Management stream. Defines comprehensive test scenarios that mirror actual plantation conditions.
  • Defect Resolution: Triages functional defects identified during testing, distinguishing between configuration errors, data issues, or mobile integration failures, and coordinates with the technical teams to resolve them.


4. Deployment, Training & Data Migration

  • Data Readiness: Supports the Data Migration team by defining data mapping and validation rules for critical upstream objects and verifying data quality after mock loads.
  • Training & Change Support: Reviews and validates training materials to ensure they are operationally relevant for estate staff. Conducts "Train the Trainer" sessions.
  • Post-Go-Live Support: Provides functional leadership during the Hypercare phase, resolving critical operational issues and ensuring stability in daily estate reporting and cost capturing.


4. Digital Ecosystem & Integration Architecture

  • Connected Applications (Integration Requirements): Collaborates with the Connected Application leads to ensure that the functional requirements for SAP S/4HANA are clearly communicated and incorporated into connected app design. Ensures that the interface specifications accommodate the data needed for SAP PS, PM, and CO processing, and to support operational and management reporting.


5. Sustainability & EUDR Compliance

  • Sustainability Process Design: Ensures that EUDR (European Union Deforestation Regulation) compliance and RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil) certification requirements are fully incorporated into the S/4HANA upstream process design.
  • Data Integration for Compliance: Verifies that the necessary sustainability data points and traceability attributes are factored into the functional designs and interface definitions across the upstream landscape.


Job Requirements:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, or a related field.

Experience

  • SAP Exposure: Strong functional understanding of SAP PM (Plant Maintenance), SAP PS (Project Systems), familiarity with SAP CO (Cost Object controlling), SAP MM (Materials Management) is required. Exposure of these modules in an agricultural context is a strong advantage.
  • Industry Expertise: Experience in Plantation / Estate Management (specifically Oil Palm or similar perennials) is preferred.
  • System Experience: Experience in designing, implementing, or supporting Plantation Management Systems (e.g., PMIS, or custom Estate solutions) is preferred
  • Implementation Lifecycle: Experience managing the full implementation lifecycle, from Detailed Design and Testing (SIT/UAT) to Data Migration and Hypercare support.

Competencies

  • Process Architecture: Ability to visualize the flow of data from field applications, through the HR payroll engine, thru SAP PS, PM, CO, MM and settling into the SAP General Ledger.
  • Operational Insight: Understanding of estate realities (e.g., how harvesting gangs are organized, how loose fruit is collected, how rainfall impacts fertilization schedules) to prevent "theoretical" designs that fail in the field.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Ability to translate estate operational needs into functional requirements for Application Leads and SAP Functional Consultants
  • Sustainability Awareness: Knowledge of data requirements for EUDR and traceability workflows.

name: SAP Group Reporting
description_html:

Accenture is seeking experienced SAP Group Reporting professionals to join our SAP Finance Transformation practice. This role is suitable for SAP professionals with expertise in financial consolidation, statutory reporting, management reporting, and enterprise finance transformation.

You will work with CFO organizations, Finance Controllership teams, and technology stakeholders to design, implement, and optimize SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting solutions that streamline financial close processes, improve reporting accuracy, strengthen compliance, and provide actionable business insights. This role combines finance domain expertise with SAP solution delivery capabilities in large-scale transformation programs.

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead or support SAP Group Reporting implementation, migration, rollout, enhancement, and support projects.
  • Gather and analyze business requirements related to financial consolidation, intercompany reconciliation, financial close, statutory reporting, and management reporting.
  • Design and configure SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting solutions aligned with accounting standards, reporting requirements, and business objectives.
  • Support end-to-end consolidation processes including:
  • Data Collection
  • Consolidation of Investments
  • Intercompany Matching & Reconciliation
  • Currency Translation
  • Consolidation Adjustments
  • Minority Interest Calculations
  • Financial Statement Generation
  • Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Treasury, Tax, and Audit stakeholders to define reporting and consolidation requirements.
  • Support integration with SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP Central Finance, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP BPC, SAP BW/4HANA, and other enterprise reporting platforms.
  • Lead data migration, reconciliation, testing, cutover, and go-live activities to ensure successful deployment.
  • Develop functional specifications, process documentation, test scenarios, training materials, and user guides.
  • Provide recommendations on financial close optimization, consolidation governance, reporting automation, and finance transformation best practices.

    • Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • 3–10+ years of experience in SAP Finance, Financial Consolidation, Corporate Reporting, Management Reporting, or Finance Transformation projects.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP Group Reporting, SAP BPC, SAP Financial Consolidation, Oracle FCCS, OneStream, Tagetik, Hyperion Financial Management (HFM), or similar consolidation platforms.
  • Strong understanding of financial consolidation principles, group accounting, intercompany eliminations, currency translation, and financial statement preparation.
  • Knowledge of IFRS, local GAAP, statutory reporting, and corporate reporting requirements.
  • Experience in requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, and business stakeholder management.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Professional proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English.
  • Willingness to be assigned on client's site (100%)


    • Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting implementations.
  • Experience in finance transformation, Record-to-Report (R2R), Financial Close, Consolidation, or Corporate Performance Management programs.
  • Knowledge of SAP Central Finance, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP Datasphere, SAP BW/4HANA, or SAP Business Planning & Consolidation (BPC).
  • Experience supporting merger & acquisition reporting integration, multi-entity consolidation, or multinational reporting structures.

Komitmen & Skema Penempatan

  • Setelah masa percobaan: Anda akan diberikan penugasan tetap dengan komitmen minimal 1 (satu) tahun kerja sesuai kontrak.
  • Penempatan peran (teknis/fungsional) akan dievaluasi setiap 6 bulan dan dapat disesuaikan dengan minat, performa, dan kebutuhan proyek.

Kompensasi & Benefit

  • Gaji pokok disesuaikan dengan kualifikasi dan pengalaman, namun tetap kompetitif untuk level entry-level.
  • Tunjangan (transportasi, komunikasi, dan kesehatan) sesuai kebijakan perusahaan.
  • Bonus kinerja berbasis proyek dan evaluasi tahunan.
  • Akses pelatihan internal dan eksternal (termasuk sertifikasi open source & data).
  • Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung eksperimen dan pembelajaran aktif.
  • Kesempatan berkembang menjadi Lead Teknis atau Analis Fungsional Senior dalam 2–3 tahun.

Cara Melamar

  • Kirimkan CV + surat lamaran singkat (maks 1 halaman) yang menjelaskan:
  • Pengalaman Anda dengan C/Java/Python dan open source.
  • Contoh bagaimana Anda menggunakan AI Tools untuk menyelesaikan masalah teknis (boleh sertakan prompt atau hasilnya).
  • Ketertarikan Anda pada dunia kesehatan dan SIMRS.

Catatan Penting

Kami mencari orang yang siap belajar, fleksibel, dan ingin bertumbuh bersama sistem kesehatan Indonesia. Jika Anda belum ahli di semua poin, tetapi punya fondasi kuat dan semangat tinggi – kami sangat mendorong Anda untuk melamar. Yang terpenting adalah kemampuan beradaptasi dan kemauan untuk berkembang.

Tertarik menjadi bagian dari transformasi digital rumah sakit? Segera daftarkan diri Anda!

Responsibilities

Dreskripsi Perusahaan

Kami adalah perusahaan teknologi kesehatan yang berfokus pada pengembangan dan implementasi Sistem Informasi Manajemen Rumah Sakit (SIMRS) berbasis solusi vertikal. Kami menggabungkan kedalaman domain rumah sakit dengan pendekatan teknologi modern, terbuka, dan adaptif. Kami percaya pada kolaborasi, pembelajaran berkelanjutan, serta pemanfaatan alat bantu cerdas untuk meningkatkan kualitas layanan kesehatan digital di Indonesia.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Secara umum, Anda akan terlibat dalam siklus hidup pengembangan dan penerapan SIMRS, baik dari sisi teknis maupun fungsional. Anda akan bekerja dalam tim lintas fungsi untuk membangun, memelihara, dan mengoptimalkan sistem yang digunakan oleh rumah sakit mitra.

Tugas Utama Meliputi

  • Berkontribusi dalam pengembangan perangkat lunak SIMRS menggunakan teknologi open source.
  • Membantu perancangan, pemeliharaan, dan optimalisasi basis data serta gudang data (data warehouse) untuk kebutuhan analisis kesehatan.
  • Menggunakan dan memanfaatkan AI tools (seperti ChatGPT, Claude, atau sejenisnya) untuk mempercepat pekerjaan, tetapi tidak bergantung sepenuhnya – kemampuan prompting untuk otomatisasi, evaluasi kode, dan optimisasi sistem sangat dihargai.
  • Bekerja secara fleksibel sebagai tim teknis (pengembang, integrasi, debugging) maupun tim fungsional (analis sistem, dukungan implementasi, pelatihan pengguna) sesuai dengan kebutuhan proyek.
  • Mempelajari alur bisnis rumah sakit (rawat jalan, rawat inap, farmasi, keuangan medis, dsb.) untuk menerjemahkan kebutuhan pengguna menjadi solusi teknis.

name: Management Information System (MIS) Coordinator
description_html:
Job Brief

Management Information System (MIS) Coordinator Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Program Background

The Australia-Indonesia Partnership for Health Transformation (KITA SEHAT) is a joint initiative between the Governments of Australia and Indonesia to support the transformation of Indonesia’s human and animal health systems, policy, and governance. The program runs for eight years (2025–2033), with total funding of up to AUD 100 million. Phase 1 runs from August 2025 to June 2029, investing about AUD 50 million. Phase 2 will extend the program out to 2033, pending agreement between the Governments of Australia and Indonesia.

The Australia-Indonesia Partnership for Health Transformation (KITA SEHAT) is a joint initiative between the Governments of Australia and Indonesia to support the transformation of Indonesia’s human and animal health systems, policy, and governance. The program runs for eight years (2025–2033), with total funding of up to AUD 100 million. Phase 1 runs from August 2025 to June 2029, investing about AUD 50 million. Phase 2 will extend the program out to 2033, pending agreement between the Governments of Australia and Indonesia.

KITA SEHAT is funded and managed by Australia’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) and implemented by DT Global. Indonesia's Ministry of National Development Planning/National Development Planning Agency (Kementerian PPN/ Bappenas ) is the primary coordinating ministry for the program, in partnership with the Ministry of Health, the Ministry of Agriculture and subnational governments in Jawa Barat, Nusa Tenggara Timur and Papua Barat Daya.

The program works towards four end-of-program outcomes (EOPOs):

  • Primary health care policy and governance – by 2033, national and selected subnational authorities have adopted improved primary health policies, service delivery approaches and governance arrangements.
  • Primary health services – by 2033, selected subnational authorities have improved the quality of and access to primary health services with a focus on stunting prevention and the inclusion of women, people with disability and other marginalised groups.
  • Health system enablers – by 2033, national and selected subnational authorities have enhanced core workforce capabilities in critical human and animal health system enabling functions.
  • Health security – by 2033, national and selected subnational authorities have increased capacity for health security and animal health policy development, strategic planning and the assessment, mitigation and management of acute and emerging health threats.


KITA SEHAT is designed to address local priorities, ensure women and people with disabilities are central to health system change, and to build climate resilience into how that change is delivered. The program is aligned to Indonesia’s National Medium-Term Development Plan (RPJMN) 2025-2029, specifically National Priority 4: Strengthening Human Resources Development, Science, Technology, Education, Health Sport, Gender Equality, and Strengthening the Role of Women, Youth and People with Disabilities

About DT Global Asia Pacific

At DT Global Asia Pacific, we aim to positively impact people’s lives through delivery excellence. As a leading implementing partner across Asia and the Pacific, we co-create locally led solutions in partnership with governments, communities, and stakeholders. We bring together talented teams and deep regional expertise to deliver initiatives that promote inclusive economic growth, essential services, and resilient, secure communities. With over 1,500 staff, experts in 22+ countries and more than 60 years of development experience, we tackle complex community, national and transnational challenges — from governance and justice systems to climate resilience, infrastructure and social equity — with innovative thinking and a commitment to long-term impact.

For more information, please see www.dt-global.com

The Role

Reporting to the Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning Lead, the Management Information System (MIS) Coordinator will lead the development, roll-out and ongoing management of a MIS for the KITA SEHAT program, working with the selected MIS provider and the Monitoring Evaluation and Learning (MEL) unit. The coordinator will act as the bridge between the program and the provider, translating business and reporting needs into clear system requirements and ensuring the delivered system meets them. The system will generate quality data for inclusion in progress reports to DFAT and the Government of Indonesia. Information generated from the system will also form the basis of briefs, infographics, dashboards and other knowledge products that will serve to support the MEL function.

The MIS Coordinator will work independently and closely with Program Leads, particularly in the period just prior to the development of the six-monthly and annual reports. S/he will provide technical advice and oversight during data entry, follow up as required to ensure quality data is provided, and maintain and continuously improve the system once in operation.

The key roles and responsibilities of the position are to provide the following:

  • Lead the development of the MIS system with the selected MIS provider, along with user manual, dashboard and training packages suitable for the program team, drawing on the MEL Adviser and IT Manager as needed. Dashboards should be able to illustrate progress, for inclusion on the KITA SEHAT website and in reports.
  • Act as the primary liaison between the program and the selected MIS provider: gather and document business and reporting requirements from the MEL unit and Program Leads, translate them into functional specifications for the provider, and review and test deliverables against those requirements.
  • Design and deliver MIS training to program staff.
  • Support program staff to enter data into the MIS.
  • Review data that has been entered into the MIS and liaise with the program team to resolve data that is unclear, incorrect, entered in the wrong location, etc.
  • Maintain real-time KITA SEHAT KPI, QI, and EOPO tracking for donor reporting.
  • Collaborate with the MEL team to integrate programmatic data into the MIS.
  • Develop annexes for progress reports that clearly demonstrate progress towards the achievement of EOPO and thematic outcomes, based on the KPIs and QIs.
  • Develop and update dashboards e.g. within the MIS itself, and the KITA SEHAT website.
  • Maintain safeguard related MIS modules and reporting.
  • Maintain and administer the MIS once operational, including user access, system configuration, issue resolution and coordination of enhancements with the provider.
  • Lead program knowledge management, ensuring outputs are archived and accessible.

Amar Bank is one of the most technologically advanced digital banks in Indonesia. Our leading digital lending product, Tunaiku has the distinction of being the first FinTech product in Indonesia. We are also the first digital bank on the cloud. As the first profitable digital bank, we managed to get listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

How did we manage to do that?

We are changing people’s perception of a bank. We believe we are the innovators who combine customer focus principles with creating technology-based impact. Founded on March 15, 1991, in Surabaya as PT Anglomas International Bank (Amin Bank), the bank was acquired by Tolaram Group and transformed to PT Bank Amar Indonesia (Amar Bank) in 2014. Technology must impact lives, must improve lives. We exist to provide banking to those who ‘need’ and not only to those who ‘want’. Services when provided to those who need at the time of their need brings smiles. Our vision is to bring 200 million smiles.

We’re looking for a Data Engineer to design, implement, and maintain reliable data pipelines that collect and process data from various public APIs into a centralised blob storage and database environment. You’ll play a key role in ensuring data is ingested efficiently, transformed cleanly, and made accessible for downstream analysis and reporting.

This role involves working with Python-based ETL pipelines, workflow orchestration (Apache Airflow or equivalent), and cloud storage solutions (e.g., Azure Blob Storage).

  • Structure data in blob storage (e.g., Azure Blob) for efficient downstream access.

Technical Skills

  • Azure Blob Storage
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines

Nice To Have

  • Experience integrating data from open economic and financial APIs (e.g., World Bank, IMF, OECD, UN Data, FRED)
  • Familiarity with large structured and semi-structured datasets (JSON, CSV, Parquet) and associated performance considerations
  • Experience building incremental ingestion or change data capture (CDC) pipelines

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset

  • Attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Proactive approach to monitoring

What We Offer

How To Apply

If you're interested in this role, please send your CV and Cover Letter to ame@amegroup.com.

name: Lead Data Engineer
description_html:
What are we looking for

real solver?


Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind. We're searching for the architects of the audacious & the pioneers of the possible. If you're the type to dismantle assumptions, re-engineer ‘best practices,’ and build solutions that make the future possible NOW, then you're speaking our language.


Your Responsibilities

What you will wake up to solve.

  • Lead Technical Design & Data Architecture: Architect and lead the end-to-end development of scalable, cloud-native data platforms. You’ll guide the squad on critical architectural decisions—choosing between Batch vs. Streaming or ETL vs. ELT—while remaining 100% hands-on, contributing high-quality, production-grade code.
  • Build High-Velocity Data Pipelines: Drive the implementation of robust data transports and ingestion frameworks using Python, SQL, and Spark. You will build integration layers that connect heterogeneous sources (SaaS, RDBMS, NoSQL) into unified, high-availability environments like BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
  • Mentor & Elevate the Squad: Foster a culture of technical excellence by mentoring and inspiring a team of data analysts and engineers. Lead deep-dive code reviews, promote best-practice data modeling (Star/Snowflake schema), and ensure the squad adopts modern engineering standards like CI/CD for data.
  • Drive AI-Ready Data Strategy: Be the expert in designing data foundations optimized for AI and Machine Learning. You will champion the use of GCP (Dataflow, Pub/Sub, BigQuery) and AWS (Lambda, Glue, EMR) to create "clean room" environments that fuel advanced analytics and generative AI models.
  • Partner with Clients as a Technical DRI: Act as the Directly Responsible Individual for client success. Translate ambiguous business questions into elegant data services, manage project deliverables using Agile methodologies, and ensure that the data provided is accurate, consistent, and mission-critical.
  • Troubleshoot & Optimize for Scale: Own the reliability of the reporting layer. You will proactively monitor pipelines, troubleshoot complex transformation bottlenecks, and propose ways to improve platform performance and cost-efficiency.
  • Innovate and Build Reusable IP: Spearhead the creation of reusable data frameworks, custom operators, and transformation libraries that accelerate future projects and establish Searce’s unique technical advantage in the market.


Functional Skills

the solver personas.

  • The Data Architect: This persona deconstructs ambiguous business goals into scalable, elegant data blueprints. They don't just move data; they design the foundation—from schema design to partitioning strategies—that allows data scientists and analysts to thrive, foreseeing technical bottlenecks and making pragmatic trade-offs.
  • The Player-Coach: As a hands-on leader, this persona leads from the front by writing exemplary, production-grade SQL and Python while simultaneously mentoring and elevating the skills of the squad. Their success is measured by the team's ability to deliver high-quality, maintainable code and their growth as engineers.
  • The Pragmatic Innovator: This individual balances a passion for modern data tech (like Generative AI and Real-time Streaming) with a sharp focus on business outcomes. They champion new tools where they add real value but are disciplined enough to choose stable, cost-effective solutions to meet deadlines and deliver robust products.
  • The Client-Facing Technologist: This persona acts as the crucial technical bridge between the data squad and the client. They build trust by listening actively, explaining complex data concepts (like data latency or idempotency) in simple terms, and demonstrating how engineering decisions align with the client’s strategic goals.
  • The Quality Craftsman: This individual possesses an unwavering commitment to data integrity and treats data engineering as a craft. They are the guardian of the reporting layer, advocating for robust testing, data validation frameworks, and clean, modular code to ensure the long-term reliability of the data platform.


Experience & Relevance

  • Engineering Depth: 6+ Years of professional experience in end-to-end data product development. You have a portfolio that proves your ability to build complex, high-velocity pipelines for both Batch and Streaming workloads.
  • Cloud-Native Fluency: Deep, hands-on experience designing and deploying scalable data solutions on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure). You are comfortable navigating the nuances of EMR, BigQuery, or Synapse at scale.
  • AI-Native Workflow: You don’t just build for AI; you build with AI. You must be proficient in using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate your delivery and have a track record of building the data foundations required for Generative AI.
  • Architectural Portfolio: Evidence of leading 2-3 large-scale transformations—including platform migrations, data lakehouse builds, or real-time analytics architectures.
  • Client-Facing Acumen: You have direct experience in a consultative, client-facing role. You can confidently translate a CEO’s business vision into a Lead Engineer’s technical specification without losing anything in translation.


Join the ‘real solvers’

ready to futurify?

If you are excited by the possibilities of what an AI-native engineering-led, modern tech consultancy can do to futurify businesses, apply here and experience the ‘Art of the possible’. Don’t Just Send a Resume. Send a Statement.

name: AVP-Data Integration
description_html:
Role

Responsible for leading the definition, development, continuous improvement, and delivery of enterprise data integration capabilities across Data Analytics platforms. The role acts as a senior individual contributor and technical platform owner for data integration, ensuring that data solutions are reliable, scalable, secure, cost-efficient, and aligned with business outcomes.

Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data integration architecture, data pipelines, data warehouse interfaces, data marts, and data exchange mechanisms between operational systems, analytical platforms, cloud platforms, and reporting/BI solutions.

Qualification

Minimum Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Telecommunication, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or other relevant technical disciplines. Master’s degree or relevant professional certification in cloud/data engineering is an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum 5–8 years of total experience in data engineering, data integration, Big Data, Data Warehouse, cloud data platform (GCP), or digital technology delivery.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in data integration architecture, ETL/ELT development, cloud data platform implementation (GCP), DWH/data mart development, or large-scale data pipeline delivery.
  • Strong experience in managing end-to-end project delivery for telecom operator, enterprise data platform, or complex digital technology environment.
  • Experience working with Agile delivery and/or structured project management methodology, including planning, estimation, risk management, delivery tracking, and production readiness.
  • Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, security/privacy, observability, and cost optimization / FinOps practices is preferred.

Working knowledge of AI/ML, advanced analytics, and real-time analytics use cases is an advantage.

Skills

The role is expected to have sufficient hands-on technical depth to review, guide, and challenge engineering implementation, while primarily focusing on architecture ownership, technical governance, delivery assurance, and continuous improvement of enterprise data integration capabilities.

General Skillset

  • Strong understanding of telecommunications business processes, enterprise IT landscape, data-driven business operations, and the role of data platforms in supporting commercial, finance, network, customer, digital, and regulatory use cases.
  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving capability to translate business problems into data integration requirements, architecture decisions, delivery plans, risks, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, negotiation, and communication skills to work effectively with business users, BI teams, data governance, enterprise architects, IT project owners, security, operations, vendors, consultants, and system integrators.

Must-have Skillset And Technology Expertise

  • Data Integration Architecture: Strong capability in integration pattern selection, batch/incremental/near-real-time pipeline design, interface specification, data exchange mechanism, orchestration design, dependency management, resiliency pattern, and production readiness review.
  • ETL/ELT and Data Engineering: Hands-on experience designing, developing, reviewing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines using GCP Platform, SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark, shell scripting, Talend, IBM DataStage, Apache Nifi, DBT, and/or equivalent enterprise data integration tools.
  • Cloud Data Platform and BigQuery: Strong knowledge of GCP data services, especially BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer / Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, IAM, service account management, monitoring, logging, and cloud networking concepts relevant to data platforms.
  • Data Warehouse and Data Mart: Strong understanding of enterprise DWH, ODS, staging layer, data mart, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schema, historical data handling, slowly changing dimensions, aggregation, semantic layer, reconciliation, and BI/reporting consumption patterns.
  • SQL, Programming, and Troubleshooting: Strong capability in SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark, API integration concepts, code review, transformation logic assessment, query/job optimization, failure analysis, root cause investigation, and development standard definition.

name: Data Platform Engineer
description_html:
About Astro

ASTRO - Groceries in Minutes

Indonesia's first and fastest-growing on-demand platform for groceries and essentials.

Anything you need, fast.

Astro is Indonesia's first quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Download our app now to experience and enjoy the new definition of fast!

Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission!


About this Position

As a Data Platform Engineer — External Data Acquisition, you will build and operate ASTRO's platform for acquiring data from external sources, including websites, web/mobile applications, APIs, public datasets, and third-party data providers.

A significant part of this role focuses on production-grade web and application data acquisition for pricing and market intelligence use cases. You will own the acquisition layer—from understanding external systems and extracting data to delivering reliable landing data for downstream processing.


Job Description:

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

  • Build and maintain reliable web/app crawlers, scrapers, and external API integrations across e-commerce, marketplace, retail, and other external sources.
  • Analyze browser, mobile application, API, and network traffic to understand how data is delivered and design the appropriate acquisition approach and runtime, from direct HTTP/API extraction to browser automation.
  • Build acquisition systems that remain reliable as external websites, applications, APIs, and data contracts evolve.
  • Handle real-world source complexity such as sessions, tokens, pagination, dynamic content, rate limits, retries, concurrency, and partial failures.
  • Build resilient and maintainable acquisition systems with appropriate testing, idempotency, deduplication, retries, safe reruns, data-quality validation, monitoring, and alerting.
  • Operate acquisition workloads using appropriate workflow orchestration, compute, data storage/warehousing, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Continuously improve reliability, scalability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership, including evaluating build-vs-buy approaches for external data.
  • Explore new technologies and AI-assisted development or automation to improve how external-data pipelines are built, operated, and maintained.
  • Collaborate with Pricing, Data Warehouse Engineering, Data Analysts, and other stakeholders to turn external-data needs into sustainable platform capabilities.


Job Requirements:

In order to launch successfully, you need to have:

  • Strong Python/software engineering fundamentals and experience building maintainable production systems.
  • Hands-on experience building or operating web scraping, crawling, external API, or similar data acquisition systems.
  • Strong understanding of HTTP, APIs, JSON, headers, cookies, sessions, authentication, pagination, and request/response behavior.
  • Hands-on experience with browser/network debugging and the ability to investigate how websites or applications communicate with their backend services.
  • Experience with both HTTP-based extraction and browser automation, using tools such as Requests/HTTPX, Selenium, Playwright, Scrapy, or equivalent.
  • Understanding of production reliability patterns such as retry, timeout, rate limiting, concurrency, idempotency, and failure recovery.
  • Solid understanding of SQL, data storage/warehousing, schema evolution, workflow orchestration, containerized workloads, and cloud infrastructure fundamentals.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, especially when working with frequently changing external systems outside your direct control.


Good to Have

  • Experience acquiring data from mobile applications, marketplaces, e-commerce, grocery, food-delivery, or other large consumer platforms.
  • Experience with asynchronous or distributed acquisition systems and high-volume crawling.
  • Familiarity with proxy infrastructure, data observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development or automation to improve data acquisition workflows.
  • Experience designing reusable scraping frameworks or shared acquisition platforms.
  • Experience with geospatial or other non-traditional external datasets.

name: Software Engineer
description_html:
**Candidates must reside in Indonesia and have existing authorisation to work there**


About Us

Revalue is a carbon credit development platform focused on one of the planet’s most critical but complex challenges - seeing nature regenerated at a planetary scale.


Our mission is to design the most cutting-edge and trusted nature credits for our planet.


We are bringing together a world-class team - forestry experts, ecologists, applied AI scientists, software engineers, geospatial analysts, commercial specialists, economists, and more - to create the unique DNA required to reimagine nature credits.


About the role

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team within Platform Intelligence.


Platform Intelligence develops the data infrastructure, machine learning, geospatial pipelines, and technical systems behind Revalue's nature and carbon intelligence products. We turn scientific and analytical work into repeatable, reliable outputs: ingesting and validating Earth observation datasets, producing the analyses and baselines that underpin our carbon methodologies, designing monitoring systems, and running the cloud platform underneath.


This role is about moving from analytical and ML prototypes to production-grade systems. You will work closely with engineers, data scientists, and analysts to build data pipelines, productionise models, and improve reproducibility, making workflows maintainable, observable, and usable by others.


Some of the most important work is deciding what to build, how to model it, and where to draw boundaries. You will work with domain experts to make those decisions rather than simply implementing predefined specifications.


It is a hands-on role at the boundary between software engineering, data science, geospatial engineering, and cloud infrastructure. You will not be expected to lead scientific model development, but you will make sure the models run reliably in production.


Who we are looking for

Please note: Candidates must have existing authorisation to work in Indonesia.


A strong mid-level or senior individual contributor who can own delivery independently and turn complex technical workflows into stable production systems.


Key skills:

  • Strong software engineering background. Design, interface, contract, data and domain modeling.
  • Scientific programming background in any domain: geospatial, remote sensing, ML, signal/audio/vision, quant, simulation, bioinformatics. We care more about the pattern of experience rather than the specific domain: translating messy, abstract, real-world structures into correct data representations and transformations.
  • Comfortable across stacks and tools: generalist disposition, able to pick up new languages/frameworks as our needs shift.
  • Familiar with modern SWE practices and product-engineering: discovery, scoping, iterative and incremental delivery, comfortable operating in ambiguity.


Hard skills:

  • Good engineering practice: testing, code review, CI/CD, modular design, documentation.
  • Experience productionising analytical, data science, or ML workflows: turning exploratory code into reliable systems, with a working understanding of batch processing, reproducibility, monitoring, and deployment.
  • Day-to-day work is in scientific Python. However, we weigh fundamentals and data aptitude above prior Python experience: if you have done this kind of work in C++, Scala, … , that counts.
  • Cloud engineering experience, ideally on GCP and AWS, including designing and operating cloud-based data systems.
  • A pragmatic mindset: knowing when to build carefully, when to simplify, and when to avoid unnecessary complexity.


Soft skills:

  • Comfortable with high-visibility, shared-ownership, collaborative work: pairing on decisions, small trunk-based commits, and real-time feedback on work in progress.
  • Comfortable running discovery sessions with domain experts before building.
  • Strong communication, including presenting technical solutions to colleagues and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Advanced proficiency in written and spoken English.


Nice to have:

Experience in any of these would be valuable, though we do not expect all of them:

  • Geospatial data, raster/vector processing, Earth observation, or remote sensing.
  • Data quality checks, lineage, observability, or reproducibility tooling.
  • Full-stack experience: a backend and frontend you have maintained or owned.
  • Applying AI tools to improve engineering, developer, or analytical workflows.
  • Tools such as Docker, GitHub Actions, Dagster, Terraform, Postgres, DuckDB, Dask, xarray, rasterio, or geopandas.
  • Scientific computing, climate, nature, carbon, or environmental data.
  • Improving an existing platform, on a team where data scientists and analysts contribute code.


What you will do

  • Make design and data-modelling calls: what a manifest has to guarantee, where a boundary sits, what belongs in a shared library and what stays out, when to defer rather than build.
  • Build and maintain the geospatial data pipelines behind our datasets: syncing sources, validating and ingesting them, and exporting project-aligned outputs for analysis.
  • Turn notebooks, prototypes, and research code into tested, modular production code, and keep it that way as requirements change.
  • Productionise our modelling pipelines and the orchestration they run on: partitioned assets, schedules, and concurrency.
  • Make runs reproducible and observable: manifests, pinned dataset versions, deterministic outputs, and monitoring that tells us when something breaks.
  • Build new data and monitoring products, including proper cataloging for our datasets.
  • Performance tuning: profiling real runs, concurrency within memory bounds, and keeping runtime/cost predictable.
  • Work on the backend (Kotlin/Spring, Postgres) and frontend (React/Remix) where results reach customers.
  • Own cloud infrastructure in Terraform across GCP and AWS: batch jobs, storage, IAM, CI/CD, and alerting.
  • Run discovery with scientists and analysts.
  • Contribute to dev tooling: ship/release scripts, agent skills that encode our engineering procedures, and repo instructions.


What success looks like

In the first few months, you will get to know our platform, cloud setup, and data workflows, and start owning productionisation work. Over time you will help build clearer patterns, more reliable pipelines, and better reproducibility and monitoring.


You will be doing well if analyses are easier to run and repeat, if analysts and scientists depend less on manual processes, if pipelines are predictable in runtime and cost, and if fewer critical systems rely on one person to keep them moving.


What We Offer

  • The opportunity to shape the future of nature-based climate finance
  • A mission-driven organisation with shared purpose, culture, and values
  • A diverse team of colleagues, partners and clients based all around the world
  • Meaningful equity in an early-stage startup with a growing and trusted brand
  • Flexible working environment with a team deeply committed to impact
  • Generously enhanced, gender-neutral parental leave policy
  • Wellbeing support, including company-funded access to therapy


🌱 If you’re ready to build our Engineering function and care about driving real impact - we’d love to meet you!

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.  

 

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

ML Platform in Agoda

Agoda ML and AI Platform is built on self-managed Kubernetes and powered by Kubeflow, an open-source solution that enables efficient machine learning workflows. 

Our AI Ops team combines the best practices of software engineering with data science to help Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists work more effectively, meaning we aim to incorporate data/model versioning, collaboration, monitoring etc. in an intuitive way that allows our users to prosper within the field.

 

In This Role, You’ll Get to:

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively in a team environment

It’s Great if you have:

  • Experience designing and building MLOps infrastructure, including data pipelines, model training and deployment systems, and monitoring and management tools.

name: Data Governance Engineer
description_html:
We are looking for a Data Governance Engineer to strengthen our data capabilities with more robust standards and policies to handle our data. This will include defining how we process the data, access the data, and visualize the data. In short this Data Governance role would be in charge to implement how we store the and and manage who can access it, also to create policies around our data warehouse and visualization tools. All these we aim to be as automatic as possible.

About the role:

  • Establish and promote proper procedures, policies, and standards to our data that enable our organization to use data more effectively and efficiently.
  • Propose and establish data quality standards, metrics, and monitoring systems to be applied in all our data stacks and ensure it is implemented well.
  • Work with business, engineering, legal, risk, and other related departments/team to set up our data policies consisting of Data Classification, Data and Dashboard User Access Matrix, etc.
  • Design and set up our Data Catalog to enable the same data understanding and knowledge among the business users, engineering, and other related teams.
  • Promote and communicate all these procedures, policies, and standards to our stakeholder and related business and maintain business flow to ensure our stakeholder could leverage more usage to our data.

About you:

  • At least 1-3 years of experience in data fields.
  • Experience in data governance related roles will be a big plus.
  • Strong understanding of data security, data modeling, data quality/monitoring, and data architecture.
  • Experience and knowledge hands on in UNIX and python programming (Spark, Airflow, and other data engineering related preferred).
  • Proficiency using SQL is a must and writing efficient SQL query.
  • Experience and knowledge hands on in cloud data warehouse (AWS and GCP preferred).
  • Strong in communication to business and technical users (Bahasa and English).
  • Experience in documenting processes, data flows, and policies are preferred.

name: Machine Learning (ML) Ops Engineer
description_html:
Requirements

Kualifikasi Minimum

Pendidikan & Pengalaman

  • S1/S2 Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Data, atau setara.
  • Pengalaman 2–4 tahun sebagai ML Engineer, Data Engineer, atau DevOps Engineer dengan fokus ML Ops.

Hard Skills

  • ML Ops Tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, atau Airflow; serta container (Docker) dan orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Integrasi Data: Rest API, ETL/ELT, sinkronasi data dari sistem transaksional (Microsoft Dynamics, database HIS/EMR seperti MySQL/SQL Server/PostgreSQL).
  • Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, atau Evidently AI.
  • Cloud/On-prem: Pengalaman dengan salah satu cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) atau on-prem server untuk model serving.

Soft Skills

  • Kemampuan mengubah kebutuhan report yang vague (dari manajemen rumah sakit) menjadi engineering tasks yang terukur.
  • Empati terhadap budaya klien yang masih manual – tidak sekadar mengganti sistem, tetapi mengubah perilaku.
  • Komunikasi yang baik untuk menjelaskan trade-off antara akurasi model vs kecepatan inferensi vs kepatuhan regulasi.

Lingkup Pekerjaan yang Spesifik untuk Daya Medika Pratama

Contoh Proyek Yang Akan Dikerjakan

  • Prediksi Okupansi Rawat Inap – Dari data EMR + Dynamics Bed Management, otomatis kirim insight ke Direktur Rumah Sakit via dashboard (bukan lagi rekap excel mingguan).
  • Deteksi Dini Risiko Pasien – Model yang memberi alert ke dokter & manajemen tentang potensi readmission atau komplikasi.
  • Optimalisasi Persediaan Farmasi & Logistik – Menggabungkan data HIS (resep, tindakan) dan Dynamics Inventory, untuk forecast stok obat dan alat kesehatan.
  • Anomali Klaim BPJS – Model yang mendeteksi ketidakwajaran klaim sebelum dikirim ke BPJS.

Paradigma Baru Yang Dibawa

“Jangan hanya report yang digenerate – berikan insight yang bisa ditindaklanjuti (actionable insight) untuk pimpinan rumah sakit.”

Responsibilities

PT Daya Medika Pratama adalah penyedia solusi vertikal terintegrasi untuk rumah sakit, mencakup Hospital Information System (HIS), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), serta ERP berbasis Microsoft Dynamics. Kami membantu transformasi digital rumah sakit di Indonesia. Saat ini, banyak klien kami masih menjalankan proses manual dalam pengambilan keputusan meskipun data sudah tersedia. Kami hadir untuk mengubah report statis menjadi insight prediktif dan preskriptif bagi para C-level rumah sakit.

Tanggung Jawab Utama

  • Deployment & Otomasi Model Machine Learning
  • Merancang pipeline deployment untuk model ML yang mengolah data HIS, EMR, dan ERP (Microsoft Dynamics) menjadi insight otomatis (misal: prediksi BOR, forecast rawat inap, deteksi fraud klaim, optimalisasi stok obat).
  • Membangun sistem continuous training dan continuous delivery (CT/CD) untuk model ML sesuai jadwal atau trigger event (misal: setiap sinkronisasi data harian).
  • Integrasi Data dari Sistem Legacy & Manual Process
  • Mengidentifikasi titik-titik proses manual klien (misal: rekap excel, laporan mingguan) dan mengotomatisnya dengan model ML yang terintegrasi ke dashboard C-level.
  • Membangun feature store yang menggabungkan data dari HIS, EMR, dan Dynamics ERP.
  • Monitoring & Governance Model
  • Memantau performa model (drift, accuracy, latency) di lingkungan produksi rumah sakit.
  • Membuat sistem alert jika model menghasilkan output yang tidak masuk akal atau data inflow bermasalah.
  • Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap regulasi kesehatan (Rahasia Medis, UU PDP, standar Kemenkes).
  • Infrastructure & Scalability
  • Mengelola infrastruktur ML (on-premise atau cloud) yang aman dan mampu menangani data rumah sakit dengan volume menengah-ke-besar.
  • Mengoptimalkan batch inference dan real-time inference untuk kebutuhan C-level (dashboard real-time).
  • Kolaborasi Lintas Tim
  • Bekerja sama dengan Tim Produk, Data Engineer, dan Tim Implementasi ERP untuk memahami alur data klinis & operasional.
  • Melatih tim internal/client engineer untuk mengadopsi ML Ops culture dan meninggalkan paradigma report-only.

description_html:
