Pengelolaan Deployment: Melaksanakan proses deployment platform data pipeline, meliputi tahap pre-check, deployment execution, hingga post-deployment monitoring untuk memastikan kualitas dan keberhasilan deployment.

Pemeliharaan & Optimasi Sistem

Melakukan deep dive analysis terkait performa sistem data pipeline dan database, mencakup configuration tuning, table, index, jobs, dan query.

Melakukan pengecekan detail pada object platform dan database untuk mengidentifikasi potensi masalah serta menentukan solusi permanen maupun langkah perbaikan berkelanjutan.

Penyelesaian Masalah (Troubleshooting): Penanganan troubleshooting tingkat lanjut dan perbaikan insiden pada pipeline logic, OS & server, storage, serta jaringan dan konektivitas.

Analisis Tren & Otomasi

Menganalisis tren performa dan penggunaan sistem (data growth, job relation & dependency, data flow, resource utilization) serta menyusun rencana peningkatan performa (improvement).

Menguasai proses otomasi (monitoring, alert, notification, analisis) dan penyesuaian performa (performance tuning) pada sistem, database, maupun server.

Dokumentasi & Transfer Knowledge: Menyusun serta memperbarui prosedur operasional, mendokumentasikan change management pada tracker, dan memberikan bimbingan (transfer knowledge) kepada tim Junior.

Pelaporan & Komunikasi: Menyusun dan mempresentasikan analisis, rekomendasi, serta wawasan (insight) terkait sistem pangkalan data kepada tim teknis maupun non-teknis.

Minimum Qualifications

Pendidikan: Minimal D3 Jurusan Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, Teknologi Informasi, Statistika, Matematika, Teknik Industri, atau bidang studi IT yang setara.

Pengalaman Kerja: Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman di bidang data operation atau development.

Infrastruktur & OS: Memiliki pengalaman dalam mengelola konfigurasi infrastruktur (server & network) serta konfigurasi OS (Linux & Windows servers).

Platform Database (Tingkat Intermediate): Menguasai platform database seperti MS SQL, PostgreSQL, IBM DB2, Elasticsearch, MariaDB, MongoDB, Apache HBase, Hive & Impala, HDFS, atau TigerGraph / Graph Database.

Query & Optimasi: Menguasai optimasi query SQL & NoSQL (database cluster & non-cluster).

Data Streaming: Menguasai operasional data streaming berbasis Confluent Kafka dan Qlik CDC.

Perangkat Operasional (Operational Tools): Terbiasa menggunakan ELK Stack, Grafana, DB Monitoring, Confluence, JIRA, dan Control-M.

Sertifikasi (Nilai Tambah): Memiliki sertifikasi seperti Control-M Basic, CDMP, Azure DP-900, SQL Intermediate, atau sertifikat data management sejenis.

name: Data Migration Specialist
description_html:
JOB DESCRIPTIONS

  • Conduct data migration meeting with client to explain how data migration process will be going
  • Prepare Data Dictionary that have explanation about table structures, data volume, formats, data quality
  • Identify data in scope for migration and data to be excluded (obsolete historical data, duplicates, etc.)
  • Define the reconciliation item agree with the client on what will be reconciled post-migration
  • Extract data from the client's legacy system according to the agreed scope and schedule
  • Coordinate with the client IT team to obtain required data access (database dump, flat file export, API, etc.)
  • Document the extraction method and ensure data integrity during the extraction process.
  • Maintain confidentiality and security of client data throughout extraction
  • Transform data per the Data Mapping Document: format conversion, reference code alignment, value normalization, and so forth
  • Cleanse data of duplicates, inconsistencies, invalid null values, and other anomalies
  • Prepare and execute validation scripts to verify completeness, accuracy, and consistency of migrated data
  • Prepare a production migration plan (rundown migration): step sequence, time estimates, and rollback procedures
  • Execute data migration to the production environment in line with the go-live schedule set by the Project Manager
  • Perform post-migration checks to confirm production data is healthy before go-live operations begin
  • Resolve data migration issue


REQUIREMENTS

  • Min. S1 in Information Systems, Computer Science, Informatics Engineering, or related field
  • Proficient in SQL for data extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation
  • Experienced working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or equivalent)
  • Able to read and produce technical data documentation (Data Mapping, Data Dictionary, ERD)
  • Familiarity with ETL tools (SSIS or equivalent) is a plus
  • Basic scripting ability (Python or Shell Script) for migration process automation is a plus.
  • Understanding of multifinance business processes: debtor data structures, instalment, collateral, and accounting entries is a plus
  • Familiarity with OJK reporting requirements for multifinance (SLIK, monthly OJK reports) is a plus
  • Detail oriented and structured
  • Strong analytical problem solving skill
  • Able to communicate technical finding clearly to non technical stakeholder
  • Maintains integrity and confidentiality in handling client data
  • Willing to travel and work on site at client location
  • Willing to work in weekend or after office hour according to project schedule

name: Data Scientist (Product Analytics) - Financial Services
description_html:
Company Description

About Grab and Our Workplace

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Job Description

Get to Know the Team

GrabFin Analytics team supports the GFin product and business organisations, across Payments, Lending, Insurance, and Kios. As a Senior Data Scientist (Analytics), you will be part of the Lending tech family where we strive to be the best FinTech company in the region. Our team is focused on understanding user experiences and partnering with Business, Product, Design, and Tech teams to achieve the right outcomes. We are integral to product development, from understanding user journeys with UX designers, to developing hypotheses, through to post-rollout optimisation.

Get to Know the Role

In this role, you'll partner closely with Product Managers to turn product and business questions into clear hypotheses, thoughtfully designed experiments, and actionable insights. You'll build a deep understanding of users—their needs, pain points, and behaviours—while keeping business goals in view. As a strategic analytics partner throughout the product development lifecycle, you'll support teams from early ideation through execution, helping shape product direction and prioritize features based on evidence and expected impact.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify data requirements and design innovative analytical solutions or insights to address complex challenges effectively.
  • Conduct in-depth analyses of operational data, including business/impact analysis and text analysis, to identify areas for improvement and process optimization.
  • Develop dashboards to monitor the performance of Grab Support operations, support specialists, and the business overall.
  • Utilize advanced statistical and machine learning techniques, such as quasi-experimental methods, NLP & LLM, to analyze large datasets and derive meaningful insights that drive business decisions, improve support performance, and mitigate risks.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in analytics and data science, leveraging this knowledge to enhance the organization's data-driven capabilities.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure data quality, integrity, and accessibility, while building data pipelines and infrastructure for analytics projects.
  • Communicate complex analytical findings to all stakeholders, including senior management, through concise reports, presentations, and visualizations.

Qualifications

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • A minimum of Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, or Engineering or any related field.
  • At least 2+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Science roles, preferably in an Internet or "Direct-to-Consumer" company with large, complex, high-velocity data.
  • Proficiency in Big Data technologies such as Spark, PySpark, and Databricks.
  • Strong foundation in data query/manipulation using SQL and data visualization tools like Power BI.
  • Experience in Snowflake and multidimensional modeling .

Additional Information

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

name: Analyst, Product Operations
description_html:
Job Description

Job ID: MJ000369

About Traveloka

Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region.

We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.

About The Team

Accommodation owns the hotel and property booking experience across Traveloka's eleven markets — from budget guesthouses to premium international chains. We connect millions of Southeast Asian travellers to a global supplier network, and you help build the pipes that make that possible: the integrations that pull live rates, availability, and rich property content into the product, accurately and at scale.

This is connectivity work where the details decide the outcome. You will shape how we onboard supply, where rates and inventory come from, and how reliably they flow — so a traveller always sees the right property at the right price. If you like turning messy, high-volume supplier data into a fast, trustworthy booking experience for an entire region, you will have real ownership here.

About The Job

As a Product Operations Analyst on Traveloka's Accommodation team, you keep the operational engine running and turn its data into something the team can act on — executing the daily processes accurately and surfacing what the numbers are telling you.

  • Execute daily service-delivery processes, maintaining accuracy and SLAs as volumes grow
  • Follow and help refine standard operating procedures, keeping the documentation acurrate and updated
  • Troubleshoot routine operational cases, escalating the exceptions that need a judgment call
  • Pull and clean operational data into clear reporting
  • That reporting is what the team uses to spot issues and trends
  • You are fluent enough in SQL or a BI tool to answer your own questions without waiting on someone else
  • Use AI tools to draft SOPs and speed up case triage, routing exceptions to a human rather than auto-resolving them

Job Requirements

  • You have at least 2 years of relevant experience.
  • You are organized and precise.
  • You stay accurate under repetitive, high-volume work.
  • You are comfortable in spreadsheets.
  • You are starting to work with SQL or BI tooling to answer your own questions.
  • You understand the basics of how the Accommodation business works.
  • You are curious about how the numbers connect to it.
  • You communicate clearly.
  • You hold a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent depth from operational and analytical work, with around a year of experience.
  • You can flag a problem with the relevant data attached.
  • You take direction well.
  • You follow through on commitments without being chased.
  • You are comfortable using AI tools to draft documentation and speed up routine work.

Join Us

If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you.

We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days.

We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.

name: Senior Commercial Planning & Strategy
description_html:
Job Summary

This role will analyze commercial performance, evaluate campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and provide recommendations to drive growth, customer engagement, and profitability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Commercial performance analysis: monitor key metrics such as GMV, MTU, AOV, GM%, GP%, and other commercial KPIs; identify trends, gaps, opportunities, and risks.
  • Campaign & promo monitoring: monitor campaign and promotion performance, including uptake, GMV contribution, basket composition, user segments, and margin impact; highlight issues and opportunities early.
  • Cross-initiative impact analysis: assess the expected and actual impact of business initiatives on sales, customers, profitability, and other relevant metrics.
  • Promotion scheme design: support the development of promotional mechanics by modeling their potential impact on GMV, MTU, GM%, and GP%; help define target customers, basket profiles, and promo economics.
  • Post-campaign analysis: evaluate campaign effectiveness, identify whether growth was truly incremental or temporary, and assess customer retention, behavioral changes, and margin impact.
  • Competitive & market monitoring: monitor competitor activities and market developments; turn findings into clear insights and recommendations for the business.
  • Ad-hoc commercial analysis: support various strategic and operational business questions through timely, data-driven analysis and deep dives.


Requirements

  • Flexible and agile mindset: comfortable working beyond a fixed job scope and adapting to changing priorities as the business grows; willing to take on new challenges and contribute wherever analytical support is needed.
  • 5+ years of experience in commercial analytics, business analytics, or another data-heavy role within e-commerce, retail, or consumer internet.
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets and/or strong SQL skills, with the ability to build models, run scenario analysis, and turn data into structured insights.
  • Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics such as GMV, MTU, AOV, GM%, GP%, funnel, cohort, and RFM, with the ability to understand what these metrics mean for business performance.
  • Ability to design and evaluate promotional schemes, with an understanding of promo mechanics, margin impact, customer targeting, basket behavior, and incremental growth.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analysis clearly and turn findings into practical business recommendations.
  • Proficiency in using AI tools to support analysis, automate repetitive tasks, improve productivity, and solve problems more efficiently.
  • Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent will be huge advantage

You can uniquely leverage your understanding of how users interact with layouts, hierarchies, and visual cues to transform complex metrics into decision-ready visual stories that help us build better features.

Key Responsibilities

  • Dashboard Design & Self-Serve BI: Design, layout, and maintain scalable, automated product dashboards (using tools like Google Data Studio, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI) prioritizing information architecture, visual hierarchy, and readability so stakeholders spot trends at a glance.
  • User Journey Mapping & Behavioral Analysis: Apply user empathy to analyze behavior data (funnels, drop-offs, clicks) against the actual UI/UX design to find out where users face friction.
  • Analytical Storytelling: Combine complex data tables with strong design fundamentals to produce high-context, narrative-driven analyses and charts that explain what happened and why.
  • Experimentation & Deep Dives: Support A/B tests and cohort segmentations, ensuring visual changes on the app/website (colors, layouts, button placements) are clearly measured and visualized for cross-functional teams.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a creative and analytical bridge between Product Management, UX Design, and Data Engineering teams to align on metric tracking and user experience.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Currently pursuing or a recent graduate of a DKV (Desain Komunikasi Visual), Product Design (S.Ds), Interactive Design, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field.
  • A strong product mindset with a passion for understanding app mechanics, user empathy, and why digital products succeed or fail.
  • Deep knowledge of visual hierarchy, layout structuring, typography, and UI/UX principles.
  • Familiarity with design and collaboration tools like Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar platforms.
  • Basic familiarity or an eager willingness to learn data tools (Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or BI tools like Tableau/Data Studio).
  • An analytical mindset—you naturally enjoy asking questions about user choices and behavioral flows.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced collaborative environment.
  • [Plus] basic familiarity with crafting UI/UX for banking or fintech key visuals or products.

name: Senior User Experience Research Specialist, ID
description_html:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


Introduction

We are looking for an experienced Senior User Experience Research Specialist, ID to join our global quality assurance team. You will be responsible for evaluating the product user experience of Trip in the ID market, identifying gaps between Trip and its competitors, and collaborating cross-functionally to address user pain points in the ID market.


In this Role, you’ll get to

  • Conduct user research to gain insights into user behavior and pain points specific to the ID market with the goal of providing actionable recommendations for product refinement and market growth.
  • Monitor product user experience (quality) metrics and provide valuable local insights to HQ teams.
  • Regularly conduct product user experience testing, in-depth competitor analysis, and local user research to identify any product quality defects and gaps compared to competitors.
  • Collaborate with other teams to address user pain points and improve overall product quality.
  • Support building data dashboards and establish data systems for comprehensive product user experience quality analysis.

What you'll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor's degree. Major in Psychology, Data Analysis, UX Research, or any related field is a plus.
  • At least 3 years of user research experience, with familiarity in both qualitative and quantitative methodologies.
  • Experiences of running full user research in the past: from planning, defining the research problem, design, data collection and analysis final report and communications. 
  • Excellent analytical skills with a strong understanding of data, preferably with knowledge of SQL and BigQuery.
  • Knowledge of design thinking and user experience is highly preferred.
  • Experience in the travel and e-commerce industry is a plus.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.


Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com



Have a good trip, and see you soon!

name: CRM Stockbit
description_html:
We are looking for a CRM to join our marketing team at Stockbit. You will manage and analyze customer data to drive customer engagement, retention, and revenue growth, working closely with the marketing, product, and data teams to optimize and personalize customer communications across our CRM channels.

In this role we especially value people who are fluent with AI. We want someone who uses AI tools to work faster and smarter every day, and who can go further by building automation and AI agents within CRM functions — to scale segmentation, personalization, and campaign execution beyond what manual work allows. If you are passionate about data analysis, customer behavior, AI-driven automation, and driving results, we would love to have you on our team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collect and analyze customer data from various sources to gain insights into customer behavior and preferences.
  • Develop and maintain customer segmentation models to optimize targeted marketing campaigns.
  • Create and execute A/B tests to measure the effectiveness of different CRM strategies and tactics.
  • Monitor and report on key performance metrics related to customer engagement, retention, and revenue growth.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement CRM strategies that align with business goals.
  • Deliver timely, important updates to traders — making sure traders always hear market-moving news as soon as possible through the right CRM channels.
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate analysis, reporting, and the personalization of customer communications.
  • Design and build automation and AI agents within CRM functions — automating segmentation, campaign workflows, and triggered journeys — to scale impact and free up time for higher-value work.

Requirements

  • A genuine interest in the stock market, and someone who is personally active in it — you invest or trade yourself and follow the market closely.
  • Strong understanding of market conditions, and the habit of actively reading news and events that impact the market.
  • Understanding of traders' needs and behavior, so CRM strategies truly resonate with our users.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, or other related fields. Fresh graduates are welcome.
  • Experience in a fast-paced industry.
  • Ability to consistently produce quality output and meet tight deadlines in a high-pressure, agile working environment.
  • Strong analytical skills, data-driven, and delighted with statistical analysis and figures.
  • Experience in project management and data analysis.
  • Understanding of the Customer Journey Experience.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.
  • A meticulous and detailed person with strong organizational skills.
  • Self-driven and a team player.
  • Take ownership of problems.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in daily work to boost productivity and the quality of analysis.

Experience In Any Of These Specializations Is a Plus

  • Building automation or AI agents within CRM functions (strong plus).
  • CRM Tools
  • Google Analytics
  • HTML & CSS
  • Microsoft Excel

name: Product Specialist (Consumer Electronics)
description_html:
Client Overview

The candidate required to work at Jakarta, Indonesia.

Our client is a leading Indonesian consumer electronics company established in 1999 and headquartered in Jakarta. The company offers a diverse range of products, including smartphones, laptops, tablets, PCs, IoT devices, wearables, and electronic accessories.

With a strong understanding of local consumer needs and a commitment to delivering innovative technology at accessible price points, the company combines agile manufacturing capabilities with a broad distribution network. It fosters a dynamic, fast-paced working environment focused on product innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.

Job Role

The Product Specialist will be responsible for strengthening the company's electronic accessories portfolio through market research, competitive analysis, technical product expertise, and product performance monitoring. The role focuses on smartwatches and smartbands, audio and TWS devices, and mobile power accessories such as power banks and chargers, ensuring products remain competitive in terms of specifications, features, pricing, quality, and market positioning.

The position will also support product certification, technical sales activities, product launches, and training for internal sales teams, promoters, and distribution partners. The successful candidate will collaborate with R&D, Legal, Operations, vendors, certification bodies, and commercial teams to ensure product readiness, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify market trends, consumer preferences, pricing strategies, and opportunities for product positioning and development.
  • Provide technical product support by preparing proposals and presentations, sharing product expertise, and assisting sales teams during customer meetings, tenders, and product demonstrations.
  • Coordinate product certification processes, including TKDN and Postel, and manage related documentation and communication with vendors, internal teams, and certification bodies.
  • Conduct product training for sales teams, promoters, and distributors, and prepare product fact sheets, sales kits, and product launch materials.
  • Monitor product quality and performance, investigate product failures, conduct root cause analysis, and recommend improvements.
  • Analyze sales data, customer complaints, and market feedback to identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Prepare monthly or quarterly reports covering sales performance, market trends, competitor activities, and strategic recommendations.


Candidate Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (S1) in Management, Marketing, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in Product Development or Product Management within the consumer electronics industry, particularly handling TWS devices, smartwatches, power banks, chargers, cables, or IT accessories.
  • Demonstrated experience in product research, competitive analysis, product positioning, product development, and go-to-market activities.
  • Practical experience in technical product presentations, product training, sales enablement, or product performance analysis.
  • Strong understanding of market research, competitive intelligence, cost analysis, profit margins, product development lifecycles, and go-to-market strategies.
  • In-depth knowledge of hardware specifications, product features, compatibility, quality management, failure analysis, and root cause identification.
  • Ability to analyze sales data, customer complaints, consumer behavior, and product performance to prepare actionable reports and recommendations.
  • Understanding of regulatory compliance and product certification requirements, including TKDN, SNI, Postel, and ISO, with the ability to support related documentation and certification processes.
  • Strong presentation, training, communication, negotiation, analytical thinking, creativity, innovation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, customers, vendors, and certification stakeholders.
  • Professional English proficiency in speaking and writing for daily stakeholder communication and reporting.

name: Product Specialist - Regional Payroll
description_html:
The job holder must ensure the payroll products are aligned and according to the employment and statutory regulations for the payroll countries. He/she must equip himself/herself with the payroll products knowledge and capable to perform his/her job independently. He/she may comprehend the requirements and regulations provided by local/regional team of the payroll countries, analyze and provide system solution diligently and able to write in Payroll Functional Specification.



About the Role



PRE-REQUISITES



  • Degree in Information System/Payroll/HR or equivalent
  • Applicants MUST possess at least 3 years of HRMS Products experience
  • Preferably Regional payroll experience in Implementation, Support and/or System Testing
  • Extensive knowledge of Payroll Product Analysis, Solution Design, Testing, writing in Payroll Functional Specification and Basic SQL
  • Demonstrates proactiveness, initiative and personal accountability to meet work demands
  • Able to work independently in a fast-paced and high demand environment


Responsibilities


  • Regional payroll product’s system solution provider
  • Analyze and test the functionality of the payroll product reported by the local/regional team and inform the party will there any change request require to the System
  • Business Process Analysis and provide system solution will there any enhancement/customization/new functionality request brought up by the local/regional team
  • Understand the employment and statutory regulations for the payroll country(ies) and align with the System
  • Request for change will there any discrepancy found from the Payroll System against the regulations for the payroll country(ies)
  • Able to write Payroll Functional Specification and understandable by all parties (including Research and Development and Quality Assurance Teams)
  • Take overall responsibility and meet the deadline and work demands
  • Ensure the key performance indicators set are met
  • Offer to take additional responsibilities as and when require
  • Interaction with Other Departments
  • Follow up with Project Management/Service Delivery/Support Team on
  • Enhancement, Customization and/or New Functionality Request for the payroll products
  • Follow up with Research and Development and Quality Assurance Teams on
  • Enhancement, Customization and/or New Functionality payroll product related request from local/regional team (if applicable)
  • Involvement in Quality Action for the regional payroll products

description_html:
Business Function

As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just right for you.

Responsibilities

  • Drive digital development for Investment & Insurance on digibank by ensuring it has superior customer journey that meets with customer needs.
  • Act as primary liaison between the digibank delivery, digibank tech and business/product owners.
